title: LETHE: Defending against Unauthorized Image-to-Video Generation via Value Diversity Collapse
title_zh: LETHE：通过值多样性坍缩防御未经授权的图像到视频生成

paragraphs.en: LETHE是一种新的防护方法，通过值多样性坍缩防御未经授权的图像到视频生成。 Image-to-video (I2V) diffusion models can animate a single reference image into high-quality, subject-consistent videos, posing threats of misuse as anyone can turn personal photos into fabricated videos without consent. A promising solution is to proactively add an adversarial perturbation to the image before release, such that videos generated from it would be unfaithful or visually corrupted. However, due to an insufficient understanding of what governs how subsequent frames read the reference image in modern I2V models, existing protections struggle to offer strong protection under common perturbation budgets. In this paper, we approach the problem by exploring this underlying reading mechanism. Through a convex geometric analysis, we theoretically identify the spread of the reference value vectors as a key factor governing this reading process, and empirically find that even a mild contraction of this spread can severely degrade the generated video, making it an efficient lever for protection. Guided by this insight, we propose LETHE, a novel protection method that directly disrupts this reading process. LETHE pairs two complementary objectives, where a value collapse objective drives the reference value vectors toward uniformity, while an attention attraction objective draws subsequent frames toward these collapsed tokens to amplify corruption. We further construct two human-centric I2V protection benchmarks and conduct extensive experiments with multiple modern I2V models, which demonstrate the state-of-the-art protection performance and versatility of LETHE.
paragraphs.zh: LETHE 是一种新的防护方法，通过值多样性坍缩来防御未经授权的图像到视频生成。图像到视频（I2V）扩散模型能够将单张参考图像动画化为高质量且主体一致的视频，从而带来被滥用的风险，因为任何人都可以在未经同意的情况下将个人照片转化为伪造视频。 一种有前景的解决方案是在发布前主动向图像添加对抗性扰动，使得由此生成的视频不忠实或出现视觉损坏。 然而，由于对现代 I2V 模型中后续帧如何读取参考图像的控制机制理解不足，现有防护方法在常见扰动预算下难以提供强有力的保护。 在本文中，我们通过探索这一潜在的读取机制来应对该问题。 通过凸几何分析，我们从理论上确定参考值向量的扩散是控制这一读取过程的关键因素，并通过实证发现，即使轻微收缩这种扩散也能严重劣化生成的视频，使其成为高效的防护手段。 基于这一洞见，我们提出了 LETHE——一种直接破坏该读取过程的新防护方法。 LETHE 结合了两个互补的目标：值坍缩目标将参考值向量推向均匀性，而注意力吸引目标则引导后续帧朝向这些坍缩的标记，从而放大损坏效果。 我们还构建了两个以人为中心的 I2V 防护基准，并与多种现代 I2V 模型进行了广泛实验，结果表明 LETHE 具有当前最先进的防护性能和广泛的适用性。
